text: Choose a path for Teddy. We can practice little steps together!
That is a step for another moment. Listen to what comes next in Teddy's plan.
Try the glowing spot. We can take one little step at a time.
A pause is okay. You can choose a different path or try this one another time.
We did it together! You can play again or choose all done.
Bedtime
Help Teddy get ready for a cozy bedtime.

Practice a pretend bathroom visit with grown-up help.

Good morning
Help Teddy start a brand-new day.
Teddy is ready for a new day. Good morning!
A little picnic
Help Teddy get ready for a picnic and tidy up afterward.
You planned a picnic and cared for the shared space.
Coming home
Help Teddy settle in after an outing.

Wash and dry hands
What comes next in Teddy's plan? Find washing hands.
Help Teddy wet, soap, rub, rinse, and dry.
Teddy practiced washing and drying hands.
Brush teeth
What comes next in Teddy's plan? Find brushing teeth.
Tap three sparkles to pretend to brush with a grown-up.

Cozy pajamas
What comes next in Teddy's plan? Find cozy pajamas.

Share a story
What comes next in Teddy's plan? Find the storybook.

Settle into bed
What comes next in Teddy's plan? Find the bed.

Good night, Teddy. Time for a cozy rest.

What comes next in Teddy's plan? Find grown-up help.
